basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old tech enthusiast currently residing in Portland, Oregon. I work as a software engineer at a mid-sized tech company, where I specialize in developing AI applications. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the gorgeous Pacific Northwest with my partner and our newly adopted 5-year-old Husky, Luna. I'm passionate about animal welfare, and I volunteer at a local animal shelter on weekends. Aside from animals, I'm a huge fan of sci-fi shows like The Orville and enjoy relaxing with video games, especially Genshin Impact. I'm usually active on Reddit during evenings and late nights after work. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, and we're both avid fans of attending HamFests to explore the latest in amateur radio technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a reputable university, and I've been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise lies in AI and machine learning, which I've honed through both formal education and self-teaching via online courses and personal projects. I'm also well-versed in animal behavior and care, thanks to years of volunteering at animal shelters and being a dedicated pet owner.
